subject: Request: Quarterly invoicing + extended payment terms for Harbor Tech
messages:
From: Priya Shah <pshah@harbortech.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>
Cc: Mark Delaney <mdelaney@harbortech.com>
Date: Wed, 28 Oct 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Quarterly invoicing + extended terms request

Connor — thanks again for the demo yesterday. Harbor Tech is excited to move forward with Redwood for inference across our payment fraud models. A couple of procurement items came up that I wanted to confirm before we exchange a PO:

- Harbor runs treasury on a quarterly cadence; we typically ask for quarterly invoicing (one invoice per quarter) rather than monthly billing.
- Our finance team prefers Net-90 payment terms on vendor invoices for new strategic deals.

I've attached a draft SOW and a procurement intent memo. If Redwood can accept quarterly invoicing + Net-90, we'll get the PO over within two weeks. If not, please let me know the quickest path to escalation.

Attachments: [Harbor_SOW_Draft.pdf (PDF), Harbor_PO_Intent.pdf (PDF)]

Thanks,
Priya Shah
Director, Procurement
Harbor Tech
From: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 28 Oct 2026 09:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Quarterly invoicing + extended terms request

Marissa — forwarding Harbor's ask. They want quarterly invoicing + Net-90 across the SOW. Deal is $1.1M ARR first-year committed, ramping in Q1 2027.

Questions for deal desk / finance:
- Is quarterly invoicing acceptable at Redwood from a revenue recognition / collections standpoint?
- Net-90 on top of quarterly invoicing essentially pushes cash out ~5 months after quarter-end; any concerns?
- If we can't do Net-90, would Net-60 + early-payment incentive work?

I can provide the SOW and PO intent; customer is ready to sign if we can accommodate.

Thanks — Connor O'Brien
Account Executive, Enterprise
Redwood Inference
(415) 555-0198
[Attachment forwarded: Harbor_SOW_Draft.pdf, Harbor_PO_Intent.pdf]
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 30 Oct 2026 11:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Quarterly invoicing + extended terms request

Connor — thanks for flagging. For the deal desk: quarterly invoicing is operationally possible but requires a billing exception because our standard cadence is monthly. Net-90 is above our standard enterprise terms (Net-30 / Net-45 typical for new accounts).

Action items I need from finance/legal:
1) Revenue recognition impact and whether we can close the quarter with quarterly invoices (cc Laura).
2) Credit assessment if we accept Net-90 (credit hold triggers, aging limits).
3) Any required contract language changes for invoicing cadence.

If finance/legal can sign off, we'll escalate to Rishi for final commercial approval because this materially affects cash flow. Putting a proposed fallback in case leadership wants to compromise: offer quarterly invoicing + Net-60, with a 1.5% early-pay discount if paid within 45 days. That keeps the deal moving and mitigates risk.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole | Deal Desk Manager
Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 1 Nov 2026 08:53:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Quarterly invoicing + extended terms request

Team — reviewed the SOW and the procurement memo. Finance concerns:
- Quarterly invoicing is workable but complicates month-end close for any quarter with a mid-quarter start; we'll need invoicing schedule in the SOW and a clear first-invoice date to align recognition.
- Net-90 is higher risk. For a new customer at this scale (> $1M ARR), we cannot accept Net-90 without verified credit references and a payment guarantee (PO with explicit payment timeline).

Proposed compromise (approved by finance if leadership buys off):
- Quarterly invoicing as requested.
- Contracted payment terms: Net-60 from invoice date.
- 2% early-payment discount if payment received within 30 days.
- Require signed PO that references Redwood SOW and explicit payment triggers; if PO not received within 30 days of SOW signature, revert to Net-30 monthly billing.

I can draft the billing clause and the invoice schedule language for legal. Marking this for Rishi's decision on final exception.

Laura Bennett
Head of Accounting & Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 2 Nov 2026 09:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Quarterly invoicing + extended terms request

Thanks team — read and agree with Laura's assessment. Harbor is strategic for our payments vertical; I'm willing to approve a one-year exception on the following terms:

- Quarterly invoicing (billing at quarter boundaries)
- Net-60 payment terms from invoice date
- 2% early-payment discount if paid within 30 days
- Require signed PO referencing SOW within 30 days; if PO not received, revert to standard monthly invoice cadence and Net-30.

This approval is contingent on: finance-implemented credit monitoring and a legal-approved amendment to the SOW. Marissa, please document the exception in Deal Desk tracker and Laura, loop in Collections for monitoring.

Rishi Malhotra
VP, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Shah <pshah@harbortech.com>, Mark Delaney <mdelaney@harbortech.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 2 Nov 2026 17:34:00 -07:00
Subject: Approved: Quarterly invoicing + Net-60 (conditional)

Priya / Mark — great to confirm next steps. Redwood can accommodate a quarterly invoicing cadence with adjusted payment terms as follows (approved by Deal Desk, Finance, and Sales Ops):

Summary of approved terms (one-year exception):
- Invoicing cadence: Quarterly (invoices issued at quarter boundaries).
- Payment terms: Net-60 from invoice date.
- Early payment: 2% discount if payment received within 30 days.
- Condition: Harbor must provide a signed PO referencing the attached SOW within 30 days of SOW signature. If a signed PO is not received within 30 days, Redwood will revert to standard monthly billing and Net-30 terms.

Next steps:
1) Harbor to confirm acceptance of these terms and return a signed SOW (DocuSign link below).
2) Upon SOW signature, Redwood will issue the first quarterly invoice per the schedule included in the attached SOW amendment.
3) Marissa/legal will send the amendment language to you for signature.

DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/link/harbor-sow
Attachments: [Harbor_SOW_Draft.pdf, Harbor_PO_Intent.pdf]
